bio: As soon as you enter this restaurant, you fall into the embrace of its inviting atmosphere: Charming tavern-style decor, soft candlelight and warm, attentive service make for a delightful setting – no wonder so many locals flock here as regulars. The Austrian cuisine is a hit – the Schmankerl Brett (snack platter) and stone-baked flammkuchen, as well as Tafelspitz (prime boiled beef) and Wiener schnitzel are crowds-pleasers, not forgetting the caramelised Kaiserschmarrn (shredded pancake) with stewed plums. There is also an appealing three- or four-course set menu dubbed Lütten Jacob Genusstafel. The wine list is exclusively Austrian, and some labels are available by the glass. No wonder this place has become a favourite of so many foodies!...
